source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.data_processing: The libraries were sequenced (single-end, 50 bp in length) using HiSeq 2500 v.2 (Illumina, San Diego, CA).
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: The media and chemicals from the 384-well plates was fully aspirated and replaced with 10 μL/well of 2X lysis buffer. The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

The plates were then shaken using an orbital plate shaker for 10 minutes. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).

The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. The plates were then checked to ensure that the cells were lysed, and if not placed back on the plate shaker for an additional five minutes. Once the cells were lysed, adhesive seals were placed on the plates and the lysates were frozen in the 384-well plates and stored at −80 °C until further processing.  The Templated Oligonucleotide Sequencing Assay (TempO-Seq™, BioSpyder Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) was used as an RNA sequencing technology of choice. Detailed protocols for TempO-seq are provided by the manufacturer and were previously reported  detailed elsewhere (Grimm et al., 2016; House et al., 2022).
